items.zh: 这个能再便宜点吗？我今天就能过来拿。
items.scene: 同城买家在闲鱼私聊卖家

answers.en: Can you do a little better on the price? I can pick it up today.
answers.note: 直接压价，用当天自取当交换条件，语气随和，适合已经有意向的买家。

answers.en: Would you take a bit less if I come get it today?
answers.note: 用 would you 开头更客气，把优惠和自取绑在一起，适合第一次联系卖家。

answers.en: What's your best price if I pick it up today?
answers.note: 直接问底价，显得熟悉二手交易，适合已经聊过一两轮、想快速成交时。

items.zh: 你大概什么时候方便来拿？我晚上七点以后都在家。
items.scene: 卖家约同城买家上门取货

answers.en: When works for you to come pick it up? I'm home after seven.
answers.note: 最中性的约时间问法，先问对方方便的时间，再补上自己可等的时段。

answers.en: What time were you thinking of stopping by? I'm around after seven.
answers.note: 语气更试探，给对方留出选择空间，适合还不确定买家是否诚心时。

answers.en: When can you swing by? I'll be home after seven.
answers.note: swing by 很口语，适合已经谈妥、只剩敲定时间的轻松交流。

items.zh: 我们在地铁站哪个出口见？东西有点大，我开车过去。
items.scene: 买家问卖家同城面交地点

answers.en: Which exit of the subway station should we meet at? It's kind of big, so I'll drive.
answers.note: 直接问具体出口，再说明开车的原因，信息清楚，适合同城当面交易。

answers.en: Could we meet at one of the exits? It's a little bulky, so I'll drive over.
answers.note: 用 could we 提出建议，语气更客气，适合第一次和陌生卖家见面。

answers.en: Which exit works for you? It's big, so I'm bringing the car.
answers.note: 先问对方方便的出口，句子短，语气随意，适合已经聊得比较熟。

items.zh: 我能先看看屏幕有没有划痕吗？没问题我就付款。
items.scene: 买家当面向卖家验手机

answers.en: Can I check the screen for scratches first? If it looks good, I'll pay right away.
answers.note: 标准礼貌问法，把验货和马上付款连在一起，能让卖家更愿意配合。

answers.en: Mind if I take a look at the screen first? No scratches, and I'll take it.
answers.note: Mind if 很口语，后半句省略主语，适合当面验货时的轻松交谈。

answers.en: Let me check the screen for scratches first, okay? If it's clean, I'll pay on the spot.
answers.note: 用 let me 加 okay 带点主导感，适合已经说好价格、只差验货时。

items.zh: 这个用了多久了？电池健康还有多少？
items.scene: 买家在二手平台问手机成色

answers.en: How long have you had it? What's the battery health at?
answers.note: 两问都直接，先问使用时长再问电池，是二手手机最常见的问法。

answers.en: How old is it, and how's the battery health looking?
answers.note: how old 更口语，looking 问当前状态，语气随意，适合买家在平台私聊。

answers.en: How long has it been used? What does the battery health show?
answers.note: 用被动语态和 show，听起来更技术化，适合对参数比较在意的买家。

items.zh: 照片是你自己拍的吗？能不能发一段开机的视频？
items.scene: 买家担心网图要求卖家补拍

answers.en: Are these your own photos? Could you send a short video of it turning on?
answers.note: 先确认照片来源，再礼貌要求视频，适合刚接触、还不放心的买家。

answers.en: Did you take these pictures yourself? Can you film it booting up for me?
answers.note: did you take 更口语，booting up 指开机，适合年轻卖家和买家之间的交流。

answers.en: Are the photos actually of the item? A quick video of it powering on would help.
answers.note: actually 带明显怀疑，后半句用委婉建议，适合照片看起来不太对劲时。

items.zh: 他一下砍了三百，我该不该直接拒绝？
items.scene: 卖家收到离谱砍价问朋友

answers.en: He wants 300 off right away. Should I just turn him down?
answers.note: 陈述对方报价再问是否拒绝，语气中性，适合先跟朋友商量对策。

answers.en: He lowballed me by 300. Should I say no outright?
answers.note: lowball 明确带不满，outright 指一口回绝，适合对方压价太狠的场合。

answers.en: He asked for 300 off in one message. Do I just tell him no?
answers.note: 只陈述事实，问法更犹豫，适合还没决定要不要继续谈的时候。

items.zh: 你这价格挂了两个月了，还能再商量吗？
items.scene: 买家看卖家挂了很久没卖出

answers.en: This has been up for two months. Any room on the price?
answers.note: 先点出挂了很久，再问有没有余地，语气平稳，适合给卖家一点压力。

answers.en: It's been listed for two months now—can we work something out?
answers.note: work something out 偏协商，强调双方各让一步，适合想长期谈拢的买家。

answers.en: Two months and still listed. Would you consider coming down a bit?
answers.note: 重复时间带明显催促，问法仍客气，适合卖家之前拒绝过降价时。

items.zh: 如果我连这个包一起拿，两个一共多少钱？
items.scene: 买家想打包买两件闲置

answers.en: If I take this bag too, how much for both?
answers.note: 最直接的打包问价，条件清楚，适合已经决定两件都想买时。

answers.en: What would you do for both if I take the bag as well?
answers.note: 把让价空间交给卖家开，语气较客气，适合想顺带争取优惠。

answers.en: How much altogether if I grab the bag too?
answers.note: altogether 问总价，grab 很口语，适合轻松的私聊或当面交易场景。

items.zh: 邮费能包吗？不能的话我到付也行。
items.scene: 异地买家在线上谈快递费用

answers.en: Could you cover the shipping? If not, I can pay when it arrives.
answers.note: 礼貌询问包邮，同时主动给出到付方案，适合第一次谈异地交易。

answers.en: Is shipping included? If it isn't, I can pay on delivery.
answers.note: 问法最中性，只确认费用是否包含，适合不想显得太计较的买家。

answers.en: Any chance you'd throw in shipping? Otherwise I'll pay when it gets here.
answers.note: any chance 带试探，throw in 指额外包上，语气随意，适合想碰碰运气时。

items.zh: 这个快递你保价了吗？这东西挺贵的。
items.scene: 买家让卖家寄贵重二手相机

answers.en: Did you insure the package? This thing isn't cheap.
answers.note: 直接确认是否保价，再说明东西不便宜，适合寄贵重物品前提醒卖家。

answers.en: Is the shipment insured? It's a pricey item.
answers.note: 用被动语态和 pricey，语气更正式，适合不熟或金额较大的交易。

answers.en: You got insurance on the package, right? It's worth a lot.
answers.note: 用反义疑问句确认，带明显担心，适合已经多次提醒过包装时。

items.zh: 能多包几层气泡膜吗？上次我收到的镜子碎了。
items.scene: 买家叮嘱卖家包装易碎品

answers.en: Could you wrap it in extra bubble wrap? The last mirror I got arrived broken.
answers.note: 礼貌提出加包装，用真实经历说明原因，适合和陌生卖家沟通。

answers.en: Can you pad it with more bubble wrap? My last mirror showed up in pieces.
answers.note: pad 指加缓冲材料，showed up in pieces 很口语，整体语气更随意，适合双方已经聊熟的沟通。

answers.en: Please use plenty of bubble wrap—the last mirror I ordered came smashed.
answers.note: please 加破折号说明后果，语气最坚决，适合担心卖家包装敷衍时。

items.zh: 他说要先交定金才发货，这靠谱吗？
items.scene: 买家怀疑遇到骗局问朋友

answers.en: He wants a deposit before he ships it. Does that sound legit?
answers.note: 把情况说清楚再问是否可信，legit 很口语，适合朋友间快速判断。

answers.en: He's asking for money up front before shipping. Is that normal?
answers.note: 只问这种做法正不正常，语气较中性，适合还没认定对方是骗子。

answers.en: Deposit first, then he ships—does this smell like a scam to you?
answers.note: 用 smell like a scam 明确表达怀疑，语气最强，适合已经觉得不对劲。

items.zh: 买家一直催我走平台外交易，我是不是该拉黑？
items.scene: 卖家遇到要求私下转账的买家

answers.en: The buyer keeps pushing me to go off the platform. Should I just block them?
answers.note: 直接说明对方反复施压，block 指拉黑，语气已经有点不耐烦。

answers.en: They keep asking to pay outside the app. Is it time to block them?
answers.note: 用 they 指买家，问法较冷静，适合想听听朋友意见再决定。

answers.en: This buyer won't stop pushing for an off-platform deal. Should I cut them off?
answers.note: won't stop 强调对方反复纠缠，cut them off 比 block 更决绝，适合已经不想再忍时。

items.zh: 你能拍一下鞋底吗？我想看看磨损到什么程度。
items.scene: 买家在二手平台问鞋的成色

answers.en: Could you take a picture of the soles? I want to see how worn they are.
answers.note: 标准礼貌请求，问磨损程度清楚直接，适合第一次向卖家要细节图。

answers.en: Can you show me the bottoms? I'm trying to gauge the wear.
answers.note: bottoms 指鞋底，gauge the wear 更书面一点，适合想仔细评估成色的买家。

answers.en: Mind snapping the soles? I want to know how much tread is left.
answers.note: mind snapping 很口语，tread 指鞋底纹路，适合懂鞋的买家快速发问时。

items.zh: 九成新是只穿过一次的意思吗？
items.scene: 买家看不懂卖家标的成色

answers.en: Does 'like new' mean it's only been worn once?
answers.note: 直接确认词义，把九成新换成平台常用的 like new，适合看不准时问。

answers.en: By 'like new,' do you mean worn just once?
answers.note: 先重复对方的说法再确认，语气更谨慎，适合不想理解错成色。

answers.en: So 'like new' means it's only been worn once, right?
answers.note: 用 so 和 right 带总结确认，语气随意，适合已经基本猜到意思时。

items.zh: 我用这个耳机换你的键盘，可以吗？
items.scene: 同城网友提议以物换物

answers.en: Would you swap your keyboard for these headphones?
answers.note: swap 是交换的常用说法，would you 开头较客气，适合正式提议时。

answers.en: Want to trade your keyboard for my headphones?
answers.note: want to 开头最随意，trade 在口语里很常见，适合熟人之间使用。

answers.en: How about we swap—my headphones for your keyboard?
answers.note: 用 how about we 提出方案，顺序先说自己的东西，适合平等协商。

items.zh: 换的话我们各自出邮费，行不行？
items.scene: 异地置换的双方商量运费

answers.en: If we swap, can we each pay our own shipping?
answers.note: 直接问能否各付各的，条件明确，适合第一次谈置换费用。

answers.en: For the trade, how about we cover our own shipping?
answers.note: 用 how about 提建议，语气更柔和，适合不想把运费谈僵的时候。

answers.en: Each of us pays shipping on our end—works for you?
answers.note: 陈述方案再确认，句尾 works for you 偏口语，适合快速拍板时用。

items.zh: 你能先寄吗？我这边信用分比你高。
items.scene: 置换时买家要求对方先发货

answers.en: Could you ship first? My rating's higher than yours.
answers.note: 直接请求加信用分理由，语气礼貌但不退让，适合对方也犹豫时。

answers.en: Would you mind sending yours first? I've got the better rating here.
answers.note: would you mind 更客气，把理由放后面，适合不想让对方觉得被质疑。

answers.en: You ship first, since my score's higher—fair?
answers.note: 用祈使句加 fair 反问，态度较强硬，适合双方僵持不下时。

items.zh: 面交可以微信转账吗？我现金不够。
items.scene: 买家当面交易问付款方式

answers.en: If we meet up, can I pay by WeChat? I don't have enough cash.
answers.note: 把付款方式和现金不足一起说清，语气直接，适合已经约好面交。

answers.en: For the in-person pickup, is WeChat Pay okay? I'm short on cash.
answers.note: in-person pickup 更明确，short on cash 较口语，适合和陌生人交易、正式一点的场合。

answers.en: Can I just transfer you on WeChat when we meet? I don't have the cash on me.
answers.note: just transfer 很随意，强调当场转账，适合和年轻卖家当面沟通。

items.zh: 这个东西还在吗？在的话我今晚就下单。
items.scene: 买家确认闲置是否已售出

answers.en: Is this still available? If so, I'll order tonight.
answers.note: 最标准的闲鱼问法，确认在售再表态，适合第一次联系卖家。

answers.en: Still have this? I'll place the order tonight if you do.
answers.note: 省略主语的短句更口语，place the order 指下单，适合快速私聊时。

answers.en: Is it still up for grabs? If yes, I'm buying it tonight.
answers.note: up for grabs 很口语，带抢购感，适合卖家刚发布、可能有人抢时。

items.zh: 卖家说可以小刀，小刀是能砍多少？
items.scene: 买家不懂小刀能砍多少

answers.en: The seller says the price is a little flexible. How much can I talk them down?
answers.note: 把“小刀”意译成价格有弹性，再问能压多少，适合不确定行情的买家。

answers.en: They said there's some wiggle room. How low do you think they'll go?
answers.note: wiggle room 指可商量的空间，问对方会降到多少，语气更口语。

answers.en: The seller's open to a small discount. How much should I ask them to take off?
answers.note: 把问题落到具体该还多少，适合想好开口金额再私聊卖家时。

items.zh: 自提的话你能帮我留到周末吗？
items.scene: 买家想周末上门自提请卖家留货

answers.en: If I pick it up myself, could you hold it for me until the weekend?
answers.note: 条件句加 hold，礼貌清楚，适合卖家还没答应留货的时候。

answers.en: Can you keep it for me until the weekend if I come get it?
answers.note: keep it for me 更口语，句子顺序更随意，适合已经聊过几句的时候。

answers.en: Would you mind holding it till Saturday or Sunday? I'll pick it up in person.
answers.note: would you mind 最客气，给出具体周末范围，适合请对方帮个忙时。

items.zh: 你发的这个序列号能查到保修吗？
items.scene: 买家买二手电脑前核对保修

answers.en: Can I check the warranty with this serial number?
answers.note: 直接问能否用序列号查保修，信息明确，适合下单前确认。

answers.en: Does this serial number still show any warranty coverage?
answers.note: 问是否还有剩余保修，coverage 偏正式，适合金额较高的二手电脑。

answers.en: Can the serial number tell me if it's still under warranty?
answers.note: 把序列号当主语，问它能否说明保修状态，语气更像在核对信息。

items.zh: 收到货发现和描述不一样，我能直接申请退款吗？
items.scene: 买家收到不符商品问平台客服

answers.en: The item doesn't match the description. Can I just request a refund?
answers.note: 直接说明货不对板再问退款，just 带一点着急，适合马上找客服。

answers.en: It arrived different from what was listed. Can I open a refund request?
answers.note: 用 different from 和 open a request，偏平台流程说法，适合正式申诉并强调按流程时使用。

answers.en: What I got isn't what was described. Am I able to get a refund for this?
answers.note: 先强调收到的不是描述那样，再委婉问能否退款，语气较缓和。
